verdict.rationale: Three.js is a rendering library and the evidence pack shows only rendering, loaders, controls, and TSL/shader features — no rigid-body physics engine, collision detection, or built-in physics simulation is documented anywhere; raycasting is mentioned nowhere either in this pack. Game developers must integrate a separate physics library (e.g. Cannon.js/Rapier) which is not evidenced here as bundled or built-in.
